sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The filter name. You can query by one or more names. Valid values:

- ServiceId: The service ID.

- ServiceName: The service name.

- Status: The service status.

- SupplierName: The supplier name.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The filter values. You can specify 1 to 10 values.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You can obtain this token from the NextToken parameter in the response to the previous request.
